coding_problems.title: Sum of Two Numbers
coding_problems.description: Write a function `solve(a, b)` that returns the sum of two integers a and b.

coding_problems.title: Reverse a String
coding_problems.description: Write a function `solve(s)` that returns the reverse of the input string s.

coding_problems.title: Find Maximum in List
coding_problems.description: Write a function `solve(nums)` that returns the maximum value in a list of integers without using the built-in max().

coding_problems.title: Check Palindrome
coding_problems.description: Write a function `solve(s)` that returns True if the string s is a palindrome, else False.

coding_problems.title: Fibonacci Number
coding_problems.description: Write a function `solve(n)` that returns the nth Fibonacci number (0-indexed, fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1).

coding_problems.title: Binary Search
coding_problems.description: Write a function `solve(nums, target)` that returns the index of target in a sorted list nums using binary search, or -1 if not found.

coding_problems.title: Two Sum
coding_problems.description: Write a function `solve(nums, target)` that returns indices [i, j] of the two numbers that add up to target.

coding_problems.title: Count Vowels
coding_problems.description: Write a function `solve(s)` that returns the number of vowels (a,e,i,o,u, case-insensitive) in string s.

coding_problems.title: Factorial
coding_problems.description: Write a function `solve(n)` that returns the factorial of n using recursion or iteration.

coding_problems.title: Merge Sorted Lists
coding_problems.description: Write a function `solve(a, b)` that merges two sorted lists a and b into a single sorted list.
